topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG generates random message sets to analyze worst-case bus utilization.
topics.real_world_use: Used in automotive network design to validate that a CAN database fits the bitrate.

topics.name: Modbus Register Mapper
topics.concept: Modbus exposes device data as numbered holding and input registers, and a register map documents addresses, data types, and scaling so masters and slaves agree.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG generates random register values to exercise map encode and decode.
topics.real_world_use: Used in industrial integration to document PLC and sensor interfaces.

topics.name: SPI Timing Visualizer
topics.concept: SPI clock polarity and phase define four modes that shift when data is sampled, and setup and hold times around the clock edge decide the maximum reliable speed.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG injects clock jitter to visualize setup and hold violations.
topics.real_world_use: Used to debug sensor and flash interfaces and to document timing for datasheets.

topics.name: I2C Address Scanner
topics.concept: An I2C scanner probes all 112 usable 7-bit addresses and notes which ones acknowledge, revealing address conflicts and missing pull-ups on a new board.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG populates a virtual bus with devices at random addresses for the scan.
topics.real_world_use: Used during hardware bring-up to verify that every expected sensor responds.

topics.name: ESD Protection Chooser
topics.concept: ESD diodes clamp transient strikes to safe levels, and the choice balances clamping voltage, capacitance for signal integrity, and the IEC 61000-4-2 rating.

key_params.data_rate_mbps: data rate in megabits per second
key_params.iec_kv: IEC contact discharge rating in kilovolts

topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG varies strike levels to compare clamping performance of candidate parts.
topics.real_world_use: Used to protect USB, HDMI, and button inputs in consumer products.

topics.name: TVS Diode Picker
topics.concept: A TVS diode stays off below its standoff voltage and avalanches to clamp surges, so the standoff must clear the normal signal while the clamping voltage stays under the protected pin's limit.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG generates surge waveforms to verify clamping stays within limits.
topics.real_world_use: Used in automotive and industrial inputs to survive load dump and inductive spikes.

topics.name: Fuse Breaker Coordinator
topics.concept: Protection coordination picks fuse and breaker curves so the device nearest a fault trips first, using time-current curves and selective let-through energy.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG varies fault current to check selectivity between upstream and downstream devices.
topics.real_world_use: Used in panel and distribution design to keep faults from blacking out whole systems.

topics.name: Relay Driver Calculator
topics.concept: A transistor or MOSFET driving a relay coil must handle the coil current and the inductive kickback, so base current, saturation, and a flyback diode are all sized together.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG varies coil resistance with temperature to check driver saturation margin.
topics.real_world_use: Used in control boards to size the drive stage for contactors and relays.

topics.name: Optoisolator CTR Checker
topics.concept: Current transfer ratio is the output collector current per milliamp of LED drive, and it degrades with temperature and age, so the design must still switch at end-of-life CTR.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG ages the CTR to verify switching margin over the product lifetime.
topics.real_world_use: Used in isolated gate drives and PLC inputs to guarantee switching across temperature.

topics.name: Watchdog Timer Configurator
topics.concept: A watchdog resets the system unless firmware pets it within the timeout window, and windowed watchdogs additionally require the pet to arrive after a minimum time.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG injects task jitter to verify the pet always lands inside the window.
topics.real_world_use: Used in safety-critical firmware to size watchdog windows for worst-case task timing.

topics.name: Brownout Detector Analyzer
topics.concept: A brownout detector holds the MCU in reset while the supply sags below a threshold with hysteresis, preventing corrupt flash writes during dips.
topics.data_idea: Seeded RNG generates supply dips to test reset assertion and release timing.
topics.real_world_use: Used in battery-powered products to pick supervisor thresholds for reliable operation.
